texts: ScrollDown: Scroll down the page. Scrolls the page down by one viewport height
ScrollUp: Scroll up the page. Scrolls the page up by one viewport height
ScrollTop: Go to top of page. Scrolls to the very top of the page
ScrollBottom: Go to bottom of page. Scrolls to the very bottom of the page
ZoomIn: Zoom in / make bigger. Increases page zoom by 15%
ZoomOut: Zoom out / make smaller. Decreases page zoom by 15%
ZoomReset: Reset zoom to 100%. Resets page zoom to default 100%
OpenTab: Go to tab or open URL. Opens a URL or switches to existing tab. Auto-switches if tab already open.
GoogleIt: Google something on the web. Opens Google with your query. Use when user wants to look something up online, google it, or find info on the internet.
YouTubeIt: Find videos on YouTube. Opens YouTube with your query. Use when user wants to find videos, watch something, or look up on YouTube.
CloseTab: Close a tab. Closes a tab by ID or name. Say 'close the google tab' or 'close facebook'.
GoBack: Go back in history. Navigates back in the current tab's history
GoForward: Go forward in history. Navigates forward in the current tab's history
Refresh: Refresh / reload the page. Reloads the current page
SwitchView: Switch between HUD and orb view. Switches between fullscreen HUD mode and floating orb mode. Browser mode shows the page with floating orb.
SetTheme: Change orb character style. Changes the orb persona/character. Three styles: robot (Om-E), kawaii (cute cat), atom (science orb).
ShowPrompt: Show the chat prompt. Shows the text input area for typing messages
HidePrompt: Hide the chat prompt. Hides the text input area for typing messages
ShowChats: Show chats panel. Opens the chats sidebar to display saved conversations. If in orb view, switches to HUD first then opens sidebar. Use when user wants to SEE their chats.
HideChats: Hide chats panel. Closes the chats sidebar UI panel. Does NOT delete chats - just hides the panel from view.
ToggleChats: Toggle chats panel. Opens or closes the chats panel
LoadChat: Load a chat. Returns full chat content including all messages. Use chat NUMBER from list OR chat_id directly.
CreateChat: Create a new chat. Creates a new chat file and returns the chat_id
AppendMessage: Append a message to a chat. Appends a user or assistant message to a chat. Creates chat if chat_id is null.
AppendUserMessage: Append a user message to current chat. Appends a user message. Uses CURRENT_CHAT_ID or creates new chat.
AppendAssistantMessage: Append an assistant message to current chat. Appends an assistant message. Uses CURRENT_CHAT_ID or creates new chat.
RenameChat: Rename a chat. Changes the TITLE of a chat. Use for 'rename this chat to X', 'call this chat X', 'change chat name to X'. The title param is the NEW name.
DeleteChat: Delete a chat. Permanently deletes a chat by number, name, or current. Say 'delete the X chat' for name.
GetCurrentChat: Get the current active chat. Returns the current chat ID and chat data
SetCurrentChat: Switch to a chat. SWITCHES to a different chat by number or name. Use for 'go to chat X', 'open the X chat', 'switch to X'. Does NOT rename - use RenameChat for that.

SearchChats: Search chats by title or content. Searches all chats for a keyword or phrase. Extract the key search term from the user's request and search. Don't ask for clarification - just search with what they gave you.
CloseSearch: Close the chat search. Closes/clears the chat search box and shows all chats again. Use when user wants to exit search mode without closing the sidebar.
GetLLMConfig: Get LLM configuration. Returns current LLM config including providers and settings
SetLLMProvider: Switch active LLM provider. Changes which provider is used for LLM calls
SetLLMEndpoint: Set LLM endpoint URL. Updates the API endpoint for a provider
SetLLMModel: Set LLM model. Changes the model for a provider
SetLLMAPIKey: Set API key. Sets the API key for a provider
SetTemperature: Set temperature. Adjusts LLM temperature (0.0-2.0)
SetMaxTokens: Set max tokens. Sets maximum response tokens
SetCapScoreThreshold: Set cap score threshold. Sets RAG confidence threshold for capabilities (0.0-1.0)
SetSessionActionsLimit: Set session actions limit. Sets rolling limit for session-wide action history (5-50)
SetLargePayloadThreshold: Set large payload threshold. Sets char threshold for large content detection (100-5000)
ClearSessionContent: Clear session content. Clears all session content from the in-memory vector store
ReloadLLMConfig: Reload LLM config. Reloads the server-side LLM agent config from disk
SetNewTabURL: Set default new tab URL. Sets the default URL for new tabs when no URL is specified
AddLLMProvider: Add new LLM provider. Adds a new provider configuration
RemoveLLMProvider: Remove LLM provider. Removes a provider from config
LLMChat: Send message to LLM. Send a chat message to the configured LLM and get a response
